prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-04-29, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2026-04-29):
| Current ratio           | 0.34 |
| Retained earnings       | 232,459M |
| Current liabilities     | 1,775,239M |
| Current assets          | 612,094M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 178,396M |
| Total liabilities       | 2,025,439M |
| Total assets            | 2,205,752M |
| EBIT / operating income | 5,851M |
| Revenue                 | 31,795M |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response: The company shows very weak liquidity (current ratio 0.34) and high leverage (total liabilities ~11x equity), with limited current assets to cover near-term obligations, despite a positive EBIT margin. These factors suggest a high risk of default and distressed credit conditions, justifying a low credit quality. DECISION: CCC+
